tri: Health areas are ranked by number of criteria met, then by number of new cases in the last 7 days.
inclusion: Health areas with at least 1 new case in the last 42 days that also meet at least one of the following criteria.

criteres.soutenu: Sustained = 3+ new cases per week, in each of the last 2 weeks
criteres.hausse: 15%+ increase = at least 3 new cases AND 15%+ increase in the last 7 days
criteres.deces_communautaires: Community deaths = 1+ confirmed death(s) with alert source 'Communauté' in the last 7 days

note_deces_communautaires: Community deaths are a linelist proxy (confirmed case, alert source = Communauté, alert nature = Décès). They count deaths alerted by the community, not necessarily deaths occurring in the community, and miss records with missing or misentered source.
